duplicate_executions_after_restart.definition: BIUs with more than one published candidate branch or more than one commit ahead of main

guards_proven_red.definition: guards whose naming test passed intact and failed when the guard was broken

known_provider_model.scope: every seeded BIU's implementation work; the control plane itself runs no provider
known_provider_model.worker: claude (Claude Code CLI, headless --print) launched by worker/run.sh in the sandbox repository

maximum_concurrent_mutating_invocations.definition: highest number of simultaneously held repository reservations across every sampled moment of the run

scope: one coherent live run of canonical Python AlienIntent against the SWF-08 sandbox; these measures describe the sandbox BIUs the factory consumed, not PY-10's own lifecycle

total_elapsed_seconds.definition: from the first isolation observation to the final post-run repository read

unknown_metrics: token_usage: the CLI worker adapter records BudgetRecord.unknown(); SWF-09 requires UNKNOWN, never zero
cost: not reported by the provider CLI in this invocation mode
